note:
project and hr_holidays: 77 -> 59, eighteen computes reading uid or lang without declaring it. Twelve are uid, six are lang.

addons/project, six findings. project.task carries three non-stored Booleans that branch on the acting user -- display_parent_task_button, current_user_same_company_partner and display_follow_button -- and all three are in TASK_PORTAL_READABLE_FIELDS, so a value computed for one portal user was reachable by the next from a cache key that omitted the user. The other three: digest.digest._compute_kpi_project_task_opened_value raises AccessError per user, project.task._compute_portal_user_names formats a list per locale, and project.milestone._compute_display_name formats a date per locale and also branches on a display_milestone_deadline context key it never declared, so that key is declared with it.

addons/hr_holidays, twelve findings. Eight uid: hr.employee._compute_show_leaves (group_hr_holidays_user or the employee themselves), hr.leave._compute_holiday_status_id, ._compute_tz and ._compute_dashboard_warning_message, hr.leave.type._compute_has_valid_allocation, res.users._compute_display_name, and both computes on the calendar report, _compute_name and _compute_is_manager. Four lang, all formatting through the environment.

hr.leave.type._compute_has_valid_allocation also reads default_date_from, default_date_to, default_employee_id and employee_id from the context; those are declared alongside uid, because a value that branches on a context key and does not declare it shares one cache entry across every value of that key.

One fix is not in this count and cannot be. hr.employee.public._compute_show_leaves does not read self.env.user itself -- it delegates to _update_fields_from_employee("show_leaves"), so the uid read is one frame away and the scanner cannot see it, while the staleness is inherited in full. It is the model a non-HR colleague actually reads, so it is the more exposed of the pair, and it is fixed here without moving the number.

That one is also the only member of this family demonstrated rather than argued. hr_holidays.tests.test_access_rights.TestShowLeavesCacheKey reads show_leaves as an HR officer and then as an unrelated colleague inside one transaction; without the decorator the second read returns the officer answer (True is not false) and a companion test fails the other way with a stale False served to the employee about their own record. Both pass with it, and the suite goes 310 -> 312.

Field._depends_context reads None for every one of these, because the decorator sits on the compute rather than in the field definition; env.registry.field_depends_context is the instrument that shows the resolved key. All nineteen declarations were verified live that way.

Measured tip and parent in a detached worktree.
